title: Orchestration cadence: roadmap wargame notes and KPI checkpoint sheet
summary: Working notes from a cross-functional wargame run to validate the Q2 feature orchestration cadence and the associated KPI checkpointing. Goal: produce an actionable, time-bounded checklist and a compact KPI snapshot that PM, Eng, SRE, and CS can use during the phased rollout. This is a running doc (notes + decisions + open questions) — not final. Key themes: alignment windows, canary cadence, rollback triggers, and SLA handoffs.

launch_readiness_checklist:
1) Canary plan defined with 3 phases: 1k rps window -> 5k rps -> full ramp. Owner: Marcus Li
2) SLA gating: 95p latency and 5xx must be within targets for 30m at each step. Owner: SRE
3) Data privacy review complete for customer-only features. Owner: Legal (Elena)
4) Rollback scripts validated on staging and smoke tests green. Owner: Release Eng
5) Observability dashboards wired: token-level cost, model-fallback counters, per-region error heatmaps. Owner: Observability
6) Support runbook: escalation tree and canned responses for top 5 failure modes. Owner: Customer Success
7) Billing metric mapping: feature flags -> usage buckets -> invoice line items. Owner: Finance
8) Communication plan: internal, beta users, public doc. Owner: Product Marketing
orchestration_cadence_playbook:
Weekly cadence (8-week window) used in the wargame:
- Week -6: Freeze rollout plan, finalize SLA windows, and schedule load tests.
- Week -4: Complete end-to-end rehearsals; surface any long-lead infra changes.
- Week -2: Open beta to selected accounts; collect quality signals.
- Week 0: Canary phase start; run 3x 30-minute ramps with SLO checks.
- Week +1..+4: Progressive traffic shift with daily checkpoint calls (15m).
Decision rules: if latency regression > 15% or error rate > 0.3% absolute, stop and rollback. If cost per token spikes > 25% without quality gains, pause expansion and investigate.
risks_and_mitigations:
- Risk: KV cache warm-up increases tail latency after rollout. Mitigation: pre-warm with synthetic prefix traffic and staggered shard activation. Owner: Serving Runtime.
- Risk: Model fallback frequency rises in certain regions. Mitigation: route policy to fallback-only pool + temporary traffic throttling. Owner: Platform Engineering.
- Risk: Billing mismatch for beta customers. Mitigation: map feature flags to temporary invoice notes and reconcile post-launch. Owner: Finance + CS.
- Risk: Observability gaps during simultaneous rollouts. Mitigation: enforce tracing hooks and synthetic transaction every 5 minutes. Owner: Observability.
- Risk: On-call overload during day-1. Mitigation: augment rotation with flywheel on-call + clear escalation to Tier 2 triage. Owner: SRE
